mapper.select: SELECT mo.order_id, mo.table_id, mo.store_id, mo.order_number, mo.pickup_number, mo.order_status, mo.pay_time, mo.points_deduction, mo.actual_pay, mo.buy_type, mo.reserve_pick_time, mo.product_total_price, mo.diners_number, mo.create_time, mo.update_time, mo.remark, -- 子查询精准统计商品数量 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ms_order_detail od WHERE od.order_id = mo.order_id) AS product_num FROM ms_order mo WHERE mo.user_id = #{userId} AND mo.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY mo.create_time DESC
SELECT mp.product_id, mp.product_cover FROM ms_order_detail od JOIN ms_product mp ON od.product_id = mp.product_id WHERE od.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT mo.order_id, mo.user_id, mo.store_id, mo.order_number, mo.pickup_number, mo.order_status, mo.pay_time, mo.points_deduction, mo.actual_pay, mo.buy_type, mo.reserve_pick_time, mo.product_total_price, mo.diners_number, mo.finish_time, mo.create_time, mo.remark FROM ms_order mo WHERE mo.order_id = #{orderId} AND mo.del_flag != 1

SELECT mp.product_id, mp.product_name, od.product_quantity, od.specification, mp.product_price, od.cumulative_add_count, mp.product_cover FROM ms_order_detail od JOIN ms_product mp ON od.product_id = mp.product_id WHERE od.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ms_order ( user_id, table_id, store_id, order_number, pickup_number, buy_type, order_status, points_deduction, actual_pay, product_total_price, diners_number, create_time, remark, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tableId}, #{storeId}, #{orderNumber}, #{pickupNumber}, #{buyType}, '0', #{pointsDeduction}, '0', #{productTotalPrice}, #{dinersNumber}, NOW(), #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.select: SELECT ms_order_detail.cumulative_add_count FROM ms_order_detail WHERE ms_order_detail.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY ms_order_detail.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ms_order_detail ( order_id, product_id, product_name, product_quantity, specification, product_price, cumulative_add_count, total_amount, product_image, create_time ) VALUES
( #{orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productQuantity}, #{item.specification}, #{item.productPrice}, #{item.cumulativeAddCount}, #{item.productPrice} * #{item.productQuantity}, #{item.productImage}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO ms_order_detail ( order_id, product_id, product_name, product_quantity, specification, product_price, cumulative_add_count, total_amount, product_image, create_time ) VALUES
( #{orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productQuantity}, #{item.specification}, #{item.productPrice}, #{item.cumulativeAddCount}, #{item.productPrice} * #{item.productQuantity}, #{item.productImage}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ms_order SET order_status = 1, actual_pay = #{totalAmount}, pay_time = NOW(), -- 同步更新支付时间 update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE ms_order SET order_status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT table_id, table_number FROM ms_table WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
SELECT order_id FROM ms_order WHERE order_number = #{orderNumber}
SELECT ms_table.table_number FROM ms_order INNER JOIN ms_table ON ms_order.table_id = ms_table.table_id WHERE ms_order.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT ms_order.order_id, ms_store.store_name, ms_order.order_number, ms_table.table_number, ms_order.actual_pay, ms_order.pickup_number,
CONCAT(ms_order.user_id, '|', IFNULL(sys_user.nick_name, '')) AS userIdAndNickname, CONCAT(IFNULL(sys_user.user_name, ''), '|', IFNULL(sys_user.phonenumber, '')) AS usernameAndPhone,
ms_order_detail.product_image, CONCAT(ms_order_detail.product_name, ' - ', IFNULL(ms_order_detail.specification, '')) AS productNameAndSpecification, CONCAT('￥', ms_order_detail.product_price, ' * ', ms_order_detail.product_quantity) AS productPriceAndQuantity,
ms_order.pay_type, ms_order.buy_type, ms_order.reserve_pick_time, ms_order.order_status, ms_order.pay_time, ms_order.create_time FROM ms_order INNER JOIN ms_store ON ms_order.store_id = ms_store.store_id INNER JOIN ms_table ON ms_store.store_id = ms_table.store_id AND ms_order.table_id = ms_table.table_id INNER JOIN sys_user ON ms_order.user_id = sys_user.user_id INNER JOIN ms_order_detail ON ms_order.order_id = ms_order_detail.order_id
ORDER BY ms_order.create_time DESC, ms_order.order_id DESC, ms_order_detail.order_detail_id ASC
